app.name: Fullscreen alerts
app.summary: Alerts from Home Assistant fill the whole screen, on a 10-inch screen too.
app.setting_on_hint: Every alert (show_alert, show_alert_choice, esp_screens_show_alert) is laid out over the whole screen. Off: Tessera's own card.
app.setting_margin_hint: The room between the alert and the edge of the screen, in millimetres. 0 fills it edge to edge.
app.setting_from_size_hint: Only on screens with at least this diagonal, in inches. 0 on every screen, 7 only on the 7 and 10 inch ones.
